name: ELPV Photovoltaic Electroluminescence Defect Dataset
description: A dataset of 2,624 grayscale solar-cell images extracted from electroluminescence images of photovoltaic modules, annotated with defect probabilities and module type.
citation: Buerhop-Lutz, C., Deitsch, S., Maier, A., Gallwitz, F., Berger, S., Doll, B., Hauch, J., Camus, C., & Brabec, C. J. (2018). A Benchmark for Visual Identification of Defective Solar Cells in Electroluminescence Imagery. 35th European Photovoltaic Solar Energy Conference and Exhibition, 1287–1289. https://doi.org/10.4229/35thEUPVSEC20182018-5CV.3.15
